Define a concept set

Source: R/lang_v2.R
omop_concept_set.Rd

A concept set is a list of OMOP concept IDs with optional vocabulary expansion. Resolution order: concepts, plus their descendants (concept_ancestor) when descendants = TRUE, plus the concepts that map to the set ('Maps to') when mapped = TRUE, minus the expansion of exclude. An object-valued exclude is expanded with its own flags; a bare vector means exact IDs. A specified set that resolves to nothing matches no row (it never means "all concepts").

Usage

omop_concept_set(
  concepts,
  descendants = FALSE,
  mapped = FALSE,
  exclude = NULL,
  name = NULL
)

Arguments

concepts

Integer vector of concept IDs (may be empty: a set that matches nothing).

descendants

Logical; include descendants.

mapped

Logical; include source concepts that map to the set.

exclude

NULL, an integer vector of exact concept IDs, or an unnamed omop_concept_set() expanded with its own flags.

name

Optional registry name.

Value

An omop_concept_set object.

Details

A named concept set is registered in the plan's concept_sets and referenced by name; an unnamed one stays inline in the event that uses it.

See also

omop_event, omop_recipe

Examples

t2dm <- omop_concept_set(201826, descendants = TRUE, name = "t2dm")
